ITA-5.59.9 ekakuṣṭhaḥ एककुष्ठः
Skin disease with lesions resembling fish scales
A skin disease characterized by anhidrosis/lack of sweating; broad-based; resembling the scales of a fish.

ITA-1.9.3.3.4 ekatva एकत्व
Singularity
Oneness or singularity (monism), in which no other entity can supplant the role of mind or psyche (manas) in the body.

ITA-5.63.61 ekavṛndaḥ एकवृन्दः
Cystic growth in throat
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a rounded swelling; raised swelling; burning sensation; itching and swelling inside the throat; nonsuppurating; soft swelling in throat; heavy swelling in throat.

ITA-5.74.7 ekaśephakṣīrapānam एकशेफक्षीरपानम्
Disorder due to excess intake of milk from single-hoofed animals (horse, donkey, etc.)
A disorder characterized by extreme heat; dullness/frigidity/ inactivity; light in nature; relives vāta in śākha; salty and sour.

ITA-1.6.15 ekāntaḥ एकान्तः
Definite conclusion
A statement which is absolute and not modified by its context.
